title: Condo Tenant Complaint Form
subtitle: Operational tenant complaint intake, evidence, qualified review, exception routing, handoff, and accountable closeout.
description: An original fillable condo tenant complaint workflow that keeps identity, property-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exceptions, communication, and closeout in one traceable record.
use_case: Use when authorized property staff need to manage a condo tenant complaint from intake through verified handoff without using the record to make legal, accommodation, screening, compliance, or professional conclusions.

sections.title: Complaint identity, safe contact, and ownership

blocks.label: Tenant Complaint reference
blocks.guidance: Use one identifier across messages, evidence, work orders, and handoffs.

blocks.label: Property and location
blocks.guidance: Confirm the exact property record before collecting workflow details.

blocks.label: Reporting and routing contact
blocks.guidance: Record only contact information needed to route and update this record.

blocks.label: Case ownership and safe communication
blocks.guidance: Do not promise absolute confidentiality; disclose only as authorized and necessary.

blocks.label: Concern categories reported
blocks.guidance: Categories support routing and are not findings.
items: Maintenance, condition, utility, sanitation, or habitability concern
Access, privacy, notice, key, lock, or security concern
Noise, conduct, neighbor, guest, staff, or vendor concern
Billing, charge, deposit, lease, service, or communication concern
Discrimination, harassment, retaliation, or fair-housing concern
Accommodation, accessibility, assistance-animal, or communication concern
Threat, violence, abuse, neglect, injury, or immediate welfare concern
Other concern requiring a separate qualified process

blocks.label: Immediate safety and preservation screen
blocks.guidance: Do not delay emergency support while waiting for routine case review.
items: Emergency services or emergency property protocol needed
Person needs a safe contact or alternate communication route
Area, access, service, or interaction needs a temporary control
Evidence, messages, video, access logs, or physical condition need preservation
Potential retaliation or adverse action needs an immediate hold
Conflict of interest requires reassignment
Mandatory or specialist reporting question needs qualified review
No immediate protective action identified at intake

blocks.label: Triage result and routing
blocks.guidance: Interim measures should be neutral, reversible, and within authorized policy.

blocks.label: Immediate action, communication limit, evidence hold, and escalation
blocks.guidance: Record fact and source; do not make a legal or credibility conclusion.

fields.label: Reported risk, action taken, person contacted, temporary measure, owner, due point, and unresolved need

blocks.label: Neutral and non-retaliatory handling
blocks.guidance: Do not retaliate or take an adverse action because a person reported a concern, requested maintenance or an accommodation, participated in review, or used a protected process. Hold uncertain action and route fair-housing, privacy, safety, employment, abuse, criminal, or legal questions for qualified review.

blocks.label: Operational and qualified-review boundary
blocks.guidance: This tenant complaint record captures operational facts, routing, evidence, and authorized handoffs. It does not determine legal rights, tenancy, responsibility, habitability, code or accessibility compliance, accommodation eligibility, screening eligibility, or a professional opinion. Authorized property staff must review applicable policy, notice, privacy, retention, fair-housing, safety, insurance, and licensed-trade requirements.

blocks.label: Reporter's account and requested outcome
blocks.guidance: Use the reporter's own words where practical and distinguish quotation from summary.

fields.label: What occurred, people or roles involved, dates, locations, impact, prior notice, and requested outcome

blocks.label: Event chronology
blocks.guidance: Use one row per material event and retain source uncertainty.

blocks.label: People, roles, and information sources
blocks.guidance: Limit collection and disclosure to information needed for this review.

blocks.label: Evidence and record log
blocks.guidance: Do not alter source material; record corrections or challenges separately.

sections.title: Condo context and responsibility
sections.guidance: Apply controls that are specific to this property type.

blocks.label: Condo workflow controls
blocks.guidance: Check only controls actually reviewed; explain exceptions in the routing note.
items: Complaint is routed to owner, manager, association, or building staff
Unit conduct and common-element conditions are kept distinct
Elevator, corridor, amenity, parking, and access evidence is location-specific
Neighbor and board communications disclose only necessary case facts
Association enforcement is not authorized by this complaint record
Accommodation, retaliation, or protected concerns receive qualified review
Conflict involving a board member or owner has an alternate reviewer
Resident response and association handoff are tracked separately

blocks.label: Responsibility and external handoff
blocks.guidance: A routing field records ownership; it does not decide disputed responsibility.

blocks.label: Condo coordination facts and unresolved questions
blocks.guidance: Separate observed facts from assumptions and identify the next authorized reviewer. For a condominium complaint, classify each issue as unit, limited-common, or common-element work before routing it among the owner, tenant, manager, board, association, security, and building vendor. Preserve elevator, corridor, lobby, garage, amenity, access-control, and building-system locations precisely. Keep board communications, association enforcement, owner obligations, resident response, conflict recusal, and any accommodation review as separate records with their own authority and disposition.

fields.label: Property-specific facts, limitations, handoff details, and unresolved question

sections.title: Neutral review plan and authorized response

blocks.label: Review scope and assignment
blocks.guidance: Reassign conflicts and keep the scope proportionate.

blocks.label: Neutral review controls
blocks.guidance: The case reviewer records an operational assessment, not a judicial finding.
items: Reporter account and requested correction are preserved
Relevant records, messages, work orders, and access logs are identified
Each person receives an appropriate opportunity to provide information
Conflicting facts and unavailable evidence remain explicit
Protected traits and unrelated personal information are excluded
Interim measures do not imply a finding or punish protected activity
Legal, fair-housing, privacy, safety, or employment questions are escalated
Proposed adverse action is held for separate authorization

blocks.label: Review activity and source log
blocks.guidance: Preserve notes in the approved confidential case location.

blocks.label: Issue-by-issue operational assessment
blocks.guidance: Do not enter legal conclusions, diagnoses, or unsupported credibility labels.

blocks.label: Proposed response, evidence basis, uncertainty, and escalation
blocks.guidance: Any adverse, legal, accommodation, or protected decision requires separate authorized review.

fields.label: Proposed operational response, supporting evidence, unresolved facts, qualified review, owner, and due point

blocks.label: Response authorization
blocks.guidance: Authorization applies only within the reviewer's role and current qualified guidance.

blocks.label: Corrective, support, and follow-up action register
blocks.guidance: Record separate actions for maintenance, communication, training, process, or specialist review.

blocks.label: Reporter response, disagreement, correction, or added evidence
blocks.guidance: A reporter need not agree with the case assessment for the response to be recorded.

fields.label: Response, disputed fact, added evidence, requested escalation, receiving owner, and status

blocks.label: Case closure verification
blocks.guidance: Closeout does not prevent a later correction, appeal, report, or qualified review.
items: Immediate and temporary measures have a final disposition
Authorized response was communicated through a safe channel
Reporter corrections and disagreements remain attached
Every promised action has evidence or remains visibly open
Retaliation or recurring-pattern monitoring has an accountable owner
Separate legal, accommodation, safety, or employment routes remain linked
Confidential access and retention controls are applied
Final outcome, limitations, and reopen route are communicated

blocks.label: Case outcome and follow-up
blocks.guidance: Do not mark closed while a required safety or response action lacks disposition.

blocks.label: Case preparation and qualified closeout review
blocks.guidance: Signatures confirm review of the operational record and do not waive rights or establish a legal finding.
